newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong gold ends lower on overseas sales.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong gold ends lower on overseas sales.

text.p: Hong Kong gold edged down slightly on Wednesday on selling interest, mainly from London, traders said.
"There was quite aggressive selling from London," said a gold trader at a local bullion firm.
Players who bought gold on Tuesday's news of U.S. missile strikes against Iraq were liquidating today, traders said.
Bullion ended at US$385.70/386.20 an ounce Wednesday against New York's US$386.15/386.55 close on Tuesday.
Local gold ended HK$8 lower at HK$3,557 a tael, following the loco London price dip, gold traders said.
The carry over charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver Society rose from -6 on Tuesday to -1 on Wednesday.
Tael gold's U.S. dollar equivalent per ounce was trading at a discount to the loco London market at US$385.70/386.20
